# Decision Title

> **Page-type: ADR / Decision record**
> Owns: one architectural decision — context, decision, consequences, alternatives, and
> validation.
> Links to (does not restate): architecture overview pages; roadmap and changelog for status.
> ADRs and standards are atomic and self-contained; do not split them.
> Required sections: Status, Date, Context, Decision, Consequences, Alternatives Considered,
> Validation, References.

**Status:** Current reference | Implementation record | Active roadmap | Historical design note | Superseded

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD

## Context

What problem or constraint forced the decision.

## Decision

The choice made.

## Consequences

What becomes easier, harder, required, or explicitly out of scope.

## Alternatives Considered

- **Alternative** — Why it was rejected or deferred.

## Validation

Tests, release evidence, operational checks, or source references that prove the decision is
implemented.

## References

- [Architecture Decisions](../architecture/decisions/README.md)
